title: Expand environment paths in Vaporize service arguments
description: Vaporize expanded environment variables in a managed service executable, working directory, and environment but passed service arguments literally.
expectedBehavior: Every service argument uses the same tilde and environment-variable projection as the executable on Windows and macOS before native service artifacts are written.
actualBehavior: Windows launch.cmd and macOS ProgramArguments now resolve each argument through the shared path resolver. Four focused service-management tests pass. Reinstalling the Ternary Bonsai task expanded its USERPROFILE model argument and the registered service started with two healthy 262144-token slots.
acceptanceCriteria: Windows percent-style environment references expand inside service arguments.
macOS tilde and braced environment references expand inside service arguments.
Resolved arguments remain correctly escaped for their native service artifact.
Existing executable, working-directory, and environment expansion remains unchanged.
A real Vaporize-managed model service starts successfully from a portable project.pkl declaration.
fixSteps: Resolve every Windows launcher argument before batch escaping.
Resolve every macOS ProgramArguments entry before plist serialization.
Reinstall and start the failed real service as an integration receipt.
